title: UTF-8 Validation
description: Validates byte sequences as proper UTF-8, rejecting overlong encodings and surrogates that attackers use to smuggle characters past filters. Validation is the gate every text input must pass.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: NFC/NFKC Normalization
description: Converts text to a canonical composed form so visually identical strings compare equal - critical for usernames, passwords, and search. Without normalization, 'é' as one codepoint and 'e' plus accent are different strings that look the same.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Encoding Detection
description: Detects legacy encodings - Windows-1252, Shift-JIS, GB18030 - in data that arrives without labels, using statistical models. Detection rescues decades of unlabeled text from mojibake.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: BOM Handling
description: Handles byte-order marks correctly - stripping them where they do not belong, honoring them where they do - across UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32. BOM discipline prevents the invisible-character bugs that corrupt concatenated files.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Transliteration
description: Converts scripts systematically - Cyrillic to Latin, kana to romaji - for search and sorting across languages. Good transliteration follows standards like ISO 9 rather than ad-hoc mappings.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Confusable Detection
description: Flags characters that look like others - Cyrillic 'а' versus Latin 'a' - the raw material of homoglyph attacks on domains and usernames. Detection consults Unicode's confusables table, not just eyeballing.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Locale Collation
description: Sorts text per locale rules - where 'ä' sorts in Swedish versus German - using CLDR data. Correct collation is invisible when right and embarrassing when wrong.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Grapheme Clusters
description: Treats user-perceived characters - base plus combining marks, emoji sequences - as single units for cursor movement, truncation, and length limits. Grapheme awareness prevents splitting characters into garbage.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Legacy Conversion
description: Converts legacy encodings to Unicode with best-effort mapping tables and clear reporting of unmappable bytes. Conversion is how the world's old data joins the modern text ecosystem.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Error Recovery
description: Recovers from malformed byte sequences with defined strategies - replacement, skipping, best-effort decode - chosen per use case. Recovery policy is explicit: silent replacement is never the default for security-sensitive text.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Streaming Decode
description: Decodes text incrementally as bytes arrive, handling split multi-byte sequences across chunk boundaries. Streaming decode keeps pipelines flowing without waiting for complete documents.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Homoglyph Checks
description: Blocks identifiers mixing scripts in suspicious ways - the classic phishing domain trick - at registration time. Checks run against the whole string, catching what character-by-character review misses.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Case Folding
description: Maps text to a case-insensitive form per Unicode rules - where 'ß' folds to 'ss' - for comparison and search. Proper folding handles the special cases naive lowercasing gets wrong.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Normalization Benchmarks
description: Measures normalization throughput across implementations and inputs so pipelines pick the right library. Benchmarks reveal the 10x differences between naive and optimized normalizers.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Round-Trip Safety
description: Guarantees text survives encode-decode cycles unchanged, tested across every supported encoding pair. Round-trip safety is the contract that lets systems exchange text fearlessly.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
